_description: Sony/Murata US18650VTC6. Curve digitized from lygte-info.dk's 0.2A (near-rest) discharge curve, 10% steps of measured capacity with 3.0V/cell as empty; values are approx +/-10mV. The 100% point is the cell's initial voltage under that light load, not the 4.2V charge voltage - packs above it just read 100%. Replaces floatwheel's task.c table, which agreed within ~25mV. floatwheel pairs this cell with BATTERY_STRING=15 (PintV and XRV boards) - use --cell-count to match your actual pack, don't assume 15S.
